trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 3 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not two different objects."; ", not a product." — state the positive claim directly

Six negation-contrast constructions, each adjudicated separately. Substantive (carve-out): 'names Li_2^q rather than merely constraining it' (uniqueness versus mere consistency, a real distinction); 'a Hopf-Drinfeld pairing ..., not a scalar multiplication' (two technically distinct operations); 'not two different objects' (the block is asserting an identification); 'It does not, by itself, determine the analytic monodromy datum' (a scope limitation, the temporal/scope carve-out). Borderline: the opener 'is not imported into the framework as a separate datum; it is the solution of a coherence condition' -- in this corpus, denying that an object is a separate input is a substantive anti-laundering claim, not a strawman, so it survives; and the run-in header 'The observable is a pairing, not a product.'
trap-negation-contrast.notes: PASS, and the closest call in the batch -- a reviewer could reasonably fail the opener. Every instance survives individually; the residual concern is DENSITY (six in one block), which category 1's rubric does not make the test. Reported in the returned anomaly list instead. Separately noted, not a trap: the two run-in headers are sentence-form rather than noun-phrase, which is a clarity-rhetorical-header matter.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Full read. Math verified where checkable: the displayed five-term relation is the Abel/Rogers identity, confirmed numerically with Rogers L at 30 dps for four (x,y) pairs, residuals at the arithmetic floor; the operator pentagon Phi(P)Phi(Q) = Phi(Q)Phi(P+Q)Phi(P) is the Faddeev-Kashaev form; and Phi_b = Phi_{1/b} with q = e^{2 pi i b^2} is the correct modular-double self-duality. The scope paragraph is the model of the (a)/(b) discipline -- it names both unformalised links, marks one 'cited rather than machine-checked' and the other 'a conjecture class' -- so 'Two links in that reading are not formalised' is honest scope reporting, not category-6.

trap-em-dash.evidence: 6 stylistic spaced dashes in 347 words (1.73/100w) — restructure into sentences

Five spaced dashes, every one an unpaired clause-joiner or trailing appositive rather than a bracketing parenthetical: '... the Mac Lane pentagon coherence -- the five reassociations of a fourfold tensor commute.'; '... rather than merely constraining it -- the dilogarithm is the unique scalar shadow of the associator.'; '... the compact dilogarithm Phi_q / Li_2^q -- the bar-even face that drives mass and binding.'; '... Phi_b = Phi_{1/b} (with q = e^{2 pi i b^2}) -- the bar-odd face carrying the decay observable.'; '... away from the roots of unity -- that datum is genuinely resurgent and remains open.' Name dashes (Faddeev--Kashaev, Hopf--Drinfeld, shuffle--associator) were excluded. Five in one block is the density signal category 3 is about.
trap-em-dash.notes: NOT fixed -- structural: five sites, each adjacent to a mathematical identification, and three of them are the block's only statement of what the appositive names. Proposed: convert the two that follow a bolded term into full sentences ('The Mac Lane pentagon coherence says the five reassociations of a fourfold tensor commute.'), and turn the two 'face' appositives into a colon or a separate clause.
